summary.text: Jim Gooch is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 12 since 1995 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the House Natural Resources and Energy Committee and was mayor of Providence from 1982 to 1986.

paragraphs.text: Jim Gooch Jr. served as mayor of Providence, Kentucky, from 1982 to 1986 and on the Providence City Council from 1990 to 1993.
He has served as president of the Providence Chamber of Commerce, the Providence Jaycees, and the Providence Ruritan Club.
His professional experience includes working as a district manager for an insurance company and as co-owner of Western Kentucky Steel Construction Company Incorporated.
Gooch took office in the Kentucky House in 1995 and is a legislative representative to the board of directors of the Green River Area Development District.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Banking and Insurance, Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs, and Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Protection committees, and he chaired the Natural Resources and Energy Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
